capture_method: curl -L against the public BambooHR careers list JSON endpoint with the job-harness-v2 HTTP user-agent
redactions: None. The fixture preserves the complete public BambooHR careers list JSON response captured from the source.
notes: The list endpoint exposes job titles, departments, employment status, empty location objects, and no salary or posted date fields.
Detail pages render as a BambooHR app shell with Open Graph metadata; no stable SSR detail payload was found for listing-level salary or geography.
